verdict.rationale: PayPal docs confirm multi-currency support (ISO-4217 currency codes, ability to block payments in currencies you don't hold, multi-currency payouts) implying it can accept and convert foreign currencies, but there is no documentation of FX rate transparency, conversion fee disclosure, or how settlement to a single home-currency bank account works end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit FX rate/fee transparency documentation, multi-currency settlement mechanics to a single bank account, and independent confirmation of fair FX handling.
